messages:
Jordan (AE): FYI - Meridian Health wants a 4-week hosted pilot but procurement insists on a hard cost ceiling for sign-off. they asked if we can do a per-token cap and drop the minimum for the pilot. looping sales-eng + revops.

Priya (Sales-Eng): hosted only? any dedicated/private needs?

Jordan (AE): hosted only. workload is mostly embeddings (~embed-1024-v1) and low-volume chat. estimate they will do ~9M embedding tokens + ~1.2M chat tokens over 4 weeks. they want predictability more than a discount.

Sam (RevOps): caps are risky with spikes. options: (1) hard per-token override with a total token cap, (2) prepaid capped spend for pilot, (3) tiered discount for first X tokens. which does procurement prefer?

Jordan (AE): procurement insists on a "hard ceiling" number they can put in the PO. preferred: per-token overrides + absolute token cap.

Priya (Sales-Eng): propose we limit overrides to first 12M tokens and 4 weeks, waive min for pilot only, and require signed POC MOU with explicit end date. what override rates are they asking for?

Jordan (AE): they proposed: embeddings $0.000004/token (list $0.00001), chat $0.00005/token (list $0.00009). cap at 12M tokens.

Sam (RevOps): need their expected daily curve to run a margin sim and check KV cache / batching savings. also need a justification text for Deal Desk. if margin hit is acceptable we can carve out a temporary rule.

Jordan (AE): quick daily sketch I sent: week1 ramp -> 2.5M embeddings, week2 4M, week3 2M, week4 0.5M. chat spread evenly ~300k/week. total ~10.6M tokens.

Sam (RevOps): thanks. running numbers now. rough math at proposed rates = embeddings ~$42.4, chat ~$60 = ~$102.4. that looks tiny vs usual revenue but check overhead (meters, concurrency). will prepare DD ask.

pricing-bot: :gear: Please use the Deal Desk template: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk-template. Attach cost sim and POC MOU. Approvals may take up to 48 hours.

Theo (Legal): if the pilot touches any regulated data (PHI/PII) we need the security questionnaire and potentially a scoped DPA addendum before approving waived minimums. Jordan, confirm data types.

Jordan (AE): Meridian says no PHI, only de-identified metrics. procurement still wants the ceiling. i'll request signed MOU + security questionnaire answers and get them back within 24h.

Ravi (Sales Manager): i'm open to a short-term exception with conditions: signed POC MOU, RevOps cost sign-off, limit to first 12M tokens OR 4 weeks, and Legal confirms no PHI. if all met i'll rubber-stamp.

Sam (RevOps): creating Deal Desk ticket DD-4601 and attaching the cost sim. summary: Meridian Health pilot - request per-token overrides for hosted API (embeddings/chat), cap 12M tokens, waive monthly min for pilot, duration 4 weeks. link: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/DD-4601

pricing-bot: :white_check_mark: Ticket created: DD-4601. Please attach POC MOU and questionnaire.

Jordan (AE): i'll upload MOU + questionnaire today and ping when done. thanks team. :pray:

Priya (Sales-Eng): once DD-4601 shows RevOps + Ravi approvals i'll draft the one-off rate card and include the token cap in the MOU clause (hard stop on usage). also suggest adding auto-notify at 80% of cap.

Sam (RevOps): yes, include an automated alert + temporary throttling policy if they hit 100% of the cap. prevents billing surprises.

Theo (Legal): i'll review MOU wording for cap & termination and confirm no-PHI note. otherwise we'll require DPA updates.

Jordan (AE): uploaded MOU v1 and questionnaire answers in the DD ticket. pinging here after upload.

pricing-bot: DD-4601 updated with attachments. Status: awaiting RevOps + Sales Manager approval.

Ravi (Sales Manager): approving contingent on RevOps margin check (if cost < $500 it's fine). good job moving fast.

Sam (RevOps): approved DD-4601. margin check passed. final conditions: overrides limited to first 12M tokens, pilot auto-stops on end date or cap, waive monthly min for pilot only. I'll attach the cost breakdown.

Priya (Sales-Eng): drafting final one-off rate card + MOU addendum. will post draft here for sign-off before sending to customer.

Jordan (AE): perfect. i'll schedule procurement signature and confirm start date. thanks everyone :rocket:
